items.title: Solving Real-World Problems Through Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Solving Real-World Problems Through Technology (PDF 132, printed 128).

blocks.text: Technology entrepreneurs ko asal zindagi ke masle tez aur behtar tareeqe se hal karne mein madad deti hai. Yeh logon ko taleem, sehat, zaraat aur karobar ke challenges ke liye digital hal banane deti hai (Figure 9.4 dekhein). Misal: online learning platforms talaba ko ghar se parhne dete hain, aur mobile apps kisanon ko fasal ki paidawar behtar karne mein madad deti hain. Digital payment systems paison ka len-den aasan aur mehfooz banate hain. Technology ko takhleeqi andaz mein use kar ke entrepreneurs aise naye hal bana sakte hain jo logon ki rozmarra zindagi behtar karein.

blocks.prompt: Technology ke zariye masail hal karne ki do misalein kitab se dein.
blocks.explanation: Online learning platforms se students ghar se parhte hain; mobile apps kisanon ki fasal behtar karne mein madad karti hain (digital payments len-den aasan aur mehfooz banate hain).
